name: Insurance Australia Group Limited
summary: Insurance Australia Group Limited underwrites general insurance products and provides investment management services in Australia and New Zealand. The company offers short-tail insurance products, including motor vehicle; home and contents; lifestyle and leisure comprising boat, veteran and classic car, and caravan; pet; business packages; farm and crop; commercial property; construction and engineering; and commercial and fleet motor.
